status: preregistered before any query to the four held-out worlds

primary_metrics.minimal_positive_set_F1: exact F1 over minimal passing binary masks at reference slice
primary_metrics.phase_region_IoU: IoU of the 5x5 continuous positive region on a canonical valid binary mask

preregistered_hypotheses.H4_relative: Generalized MEES mean structural_score = .55*minimal_set_F1 + .45*phase_IoU exceeds the best frozen baseline by >= 0.15

verdict_rule: PASS only if H1-H4 all pass.
important_scope: Only validates this factorable non-monotone benchmark family; does not establish general causal-discovery superiority.
